description: Get the full catalog of all 170 US volcanoes tracked by the USGS Volcano Hazards Program. Includes Alaska, Hawaii, Cascades (Washington/Oregon/California), and other regions. Each entry contains: Smithsonian volcano number (vnum), USGS volcano code, region, GPS coordinates, elevation, NVEWS threat rating (Very High / High / Moderate / Low / Very Low), observatory contact, official volcano page URL, and image URL. Optionally filter by region substring (e.g. "Alaska", "Hawaii", "Cascades"). Use to enumerate all US volcanoes, discover IDs, or build regional hazard maps. No auth — USGS public domain.
name: volcano.catalog.us
